cohort.memory: cold per family and per role, maintain learned source-selected context/value across exactly 3 original seeds; no source model shared across arms

mechanism.name: Hand-engineered public mission-action consequence eligibility learning, not independently discovered semantics
mechanism.base: Import original MG47 DoorMemoryNavigation and original MG50 PublicTransitionPredictor from exact unchanged ancestor. Candidate/ablation use untouched MG47 door memory and MG44 release/target FSM, no MG50 view-change steering.
mechanism.public_context: Mission literal target color/type, front-source object type and state and heading, plus a boolean for exact mission-target visible anywhere in 7x7 public image. Form compact string; does not include privileged map/inventory/position.
mechanism.source_events: Only own selected original Farama action and next observation, source public exact new target visibility, source locked-door state 2 to 0 observed effect, selected mission-target pickup disappearance, and positive original terminal goal reward. These public event definitions and weights are explicit manually designed features, not causal discovery.
mechanism.eligibility: Each genuine own-selected source action increments (context,action) sample count. Retain 8 most recent within-episode selected context-action keys, reset recent trace on episode reset; preserve aggregated sample and positive credit across 3 seeds within family. On any engineered goal-relevance event, add positive event credit to each of last 8 trace entries weighted geometrically (newest 1, preceding 1/2, 1/4 ...). An event is credited at most once per source step; if multiple, add weights. Does not use unseen future action feedback to select its earlier action.
mechanism.choice: Original MG47 choose first. Override only in phase seek, original selected action is 0,1,or2, no exact source mission target in front, and candidate has >=2 prior own-selected samples of (public abstraction,action). Choose action with highest empirically accumulated discounted goal-relevance credit divided by (sample count+2), only if it exceeds parent-score value by >=0.5. Skip forward if front wall or non-open door or portable object. Tie original then lowest action. No override of pickup, drop, door toggle, release/retry or visible target.
mechanism.bounded_memory: At most 2048 context-action keys within a family; ignore new keys once full, preserve existing prior evidence. Do not share across role/family. Cold checkpoint exact schema verifies all counts and credits.
mechanism.known_limits: Public first-sighting and public goal semantics engineered; eligibility correlation not proof that preceding selected action caused later reward; early successes/target encounters may be too sparse for value steering.

metrics.primary: genuine original mission-target first visible frames and positive reward/terminated goals in larger KeyCorridors; true positive ObstructedMaze goals
metrics.secondary: actual source mission-target selected pickups, actual locked-door openings, action budget, number of true own-selected value overrides and public goal-relevant credit events, cold-checkpoint retention, source action histograms
comparisons: identical eligibility learning with steering disabled
unchanged MG34 graph lookahead, exact MG33C action-only UCB/RR
metrics.computational: episode original source actions and wall/Python/child CPU deltas; NOT full matched Go CPU/RSS/energy

candidate at least one authentic positive goal episode in a larger KeyCorridor

candidate total positive original goals strictly greater than every preregistered comparator, including matched eligibility-steering disabled arm
